changes: An observed video-attribution avatar/label row can be linkless and can contain an aria-hidden visual duplicate. Read its actual next public native/history destination, never infer its handle or a parent post URL.

Feed attribution opens a retained preview. Attribution inside a preview opens/selects an independent retained target tab. Only the closed videoSourcePreview action/armVideoSource intent receives this preview override; ordinary preview navigation remains native. Ctrl keeps existing background semantics and exact-target reuse.

Finish bounded original-document reconciliation and scroll restoration before selecting a source tab that conceals the old preview. New input, owner, route, visibility or deadline changes revoke stale work.
Attribution gestures do not claim manual playback. Play/pause/seek/fullscreen and native media/photo routes remain source-owned.

The actually observed /i/status and /i/web/status aliases reuse an already observed canonical post tab only for the same validated numeric post ID. Normal profile/author paths, different IDs and media subroutes remain distinct.

Prepare Lens destinations through actual bounded Google HTTP Location responses before publication, at most four workers with one three-second deadline inside the provider budget. Resolve duplicate wrappers once, never request the final destination at this stage, and keep unresolved originals usable.
Resolved links display their actual destination host. Unresolved /goto and /url links display 주소 확인 필요 and retain indexed provider fallback. No title-based destination guessing.

Danbooru incoming links remain pending until their exact current request settles. Guarded microtask dispatch survives StrictMode replay without duplicate requests; cancellation/privacy cannot consume a not-yet-completed link or leave first-entry loading stuck.

Recognize the actually observed Lens 일치검색 결과를 찾을 수 없음 notice in a unique visible results scope. The observed center_col fallback is empty-only, never a new result-card layout. Unknown/loading/ambiguous scopes or unparsed outgoing sources do not become zero matches, and notices outside the results scope do not authorize alternatives.
The observed SauceNAO 521 outage title produces a truthful server-unavailable error. It is not no-match evidence and never triggers automatic retries or cancels the other provider.

A potential retained Google /url or ambiguous /goto wrapper in the results scope prevents a zero classification while it is unparsed. This only strengthens the empty guard; result-card admission and observed direct-destination resolution remain unchanged.
